title: f120.7: wire SmtpRelayQueue into JMAP Email/set create handler
description:
Wire the SmtpRelayQueue into the JMAP Email/set create handler so articles are relayed to SMTP peers after being written to IPFS.

**What:** After handle_email_create writes article to IPFS, if smtp_relay_queue is Some and article has To:/Cc: recipients, enqueue the article for SMTP relay delivery.

**Algorithm:**
1. Read crates/mail/src/email/set.rs fully, specifically handle_email_create (lines ~117-203)
2. Read crates/mail/src/config.rs to understand DeliveryConfig reference in AppState
3. Extend handle_email_create signature: add smtp_queue: Option<&Arc<SmtpRelayQueue>> parameter
4. After write_article_to_ipfs() succeeds (around line 201):
   a. Extract To: and Cc: header values from the article (parse RFC 5322 addresses from to/cc fields if present in the JMAP create_map)
   b. If rcpt_list is non-empty and smtp_queue is Some:
      - Extract MAIL FROM from from_email (the From: header value already parsed on line ~189)
      - Call smtp_queue.enqueue(article.as_bytes(), &mail_from, &rcpt_list).await
      - On Err: tracing::warn!(creation_id=%id, 'smtp relay enqueue failed: {e}') — non-fatal, do NOT fail the JMAP response
5. Update all callers of handle_email_create to pass smtp_queue from AppState (or None if not configured)
6. Add smtp_relay_queue: Option<Arc<SmtpRelayQueue>> field to AppState or wherever the JMAP handler is initialized
7. Initialize SmtpRelayQueue in server startup if delivery.smtp_relay_peers is non-empty

**Defensive programming rules:**
- SMTP enqueue failure MUST NOT cause handle_email_create to return an error — it is fire-and-forget
- Never log To: or Cc: addresses at warn/error level (privacy)
- If smtp_relay_peers is empty, skip silently (no log)
- MAIL FROM: use the first address from the From: field, not raw header string

**Tests:**
- Test: handle_email_create with smtp_queue=None does not attempt delivery (oracle: no files in temp queue_dir)
- Test: handle_email_create with smtp_queue=Some and article with To: header — queue_dir gets .env file after call (oracle: file system check)
- Test: handle_email_create with smtp_queue=Some but IPFS write fails — no enqueue (oracle: file system empty)
- Test: handle_email_create with smtp_queue=Some but article has no To: or Cc: — no enqueue (oracle: file system empty)

**Acceptance:**
- cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-mail passes
- cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-smtp passes
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
- Integration: Email/set create with To: recipient enqueues article in relay queue
